id: title:Gilbert09:classify a pyarrow mid stream truncation as retryable

review.posthog_relevance: ClickHouse warehouse ingestion reliability and recovery
review.reason: Adds a retryable error entry for ClickHouse data import failures, allowing ingestion activities to retry when PyArrow detects a mid-stream connection drop rather than failing immediately. P1.F1.H1 adds the retryable error entry; P1.F2.H1 adds a regression test assertion for this failure mode. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in the reliability and recovery of the
review.uncertainty: The actual production benefit and frequency of this specific failure mode are not established by the code alone; the implementation and test coverage are visible, but the operational impact is unverified.
